body: Silero VAD: pre-trained enterprise-grade Voice Activity Detector
plain_description: **Find where speech occurs in audio so your team can prepare recordings and automate voice workflows.** Works for call centers, voice bots, and edge or mobile use cases. Processes audio locally without telemetry, keys, or registration.
technical_description: Silero VAD is a pre-trained voice activity detector. Its Python package accepts audio and returns speech timestamps. The README documents PyTorch and ONNX options, CPU and GPU execution, and support for 8 kHz and 16 kHz audio. Python examples require at least 1 GB RAM and a modern AVX-capable CPU; ONNX Runtime can support other architectures.
title: Silero VAD
